src: APPSC Asst. Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Service

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test GS-MA 201

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Hydrogeology) in AP Ground Water

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test 2017

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer, APRO, ASO and other posts

src: APPSC Endowment Paper-I Executive Officer Grade-III 2023
s: By which year will Andhra Pradesh's new IT policy for 2021-24 be in force?
x: The AP IT Policy 2021-24 runs retrospectively from 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2024 (unless superseded); the other dates are distractors.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s: According to the local procurement clause in Andhra Pradesh of the AP IT Policy for 2021-2024, for IT requirements up to a value of Rs.1 crore, the government will:
o: procure exclusively from IT companies or start-ups registered in India
procure only from IT companies or startups registered in Andhra Pradesh
procure exclusively from IT companies or start-ups operating in Andhra Pradesh, provided their quality is comparable
give preference to IT companies or startups operating in Andhra Pradesh, but not exclusively
x: The IT Policy 2021-24 local-procurement clause buys IT needs up to ₹1 crore exclusively from IT companies or start-ups operating in AP, provided quality is comparable – not merely a preference, and not 'registered in AP'.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud

x: LIFT stands for Land Incentive for Tech Hubs – land offered to GCCs and IT infrastructure developers.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Colleges Lecturers (Engineering & Non-Engi
s: Which of the following is correct as per the Andhra Pradesh IT Policy 2021-24

A multinational corporation (MNC) has facilities and assets in at least five countries other than its home country.
An entry level IT professional/ job is defined as an employee whose annual cost-to-company (CTC) is up to Rs.5 lakh per annum.
A high-end IT professional/job is defined as an employee whose annual CTC is more than Rs.15 lakh per annum.
x: The AP IT Policy 2021-24 defines an entry-level IT job as annual CTC up to Rs 5 lakh. An MNC needs facilities in at least one (not five) country besides its home country, and a high-end job is CTC above Rs 10 lakh (not 15).

src: APPSC Assistant Conservator of Forest 2022

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General

First time employment creation of 5 lakhs
First time entrepreneurship creation of 2 lakhs

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test GS-MA 201

src: APPSC Junior Assistant in Dr. NTR University of Health Scien
s: Which of the following is the nodal agency for the computerisation of the Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Societies (PACCS) in Andhra Pradesh?
o: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
x:
Most keys: APCOB (State nodal agency). Strictly, under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme NABARD is the national-level implementing agency; APCOB is the State-level agency in AP (indiancooperative.com; general knowledge).
In Andhra Pradesh the computerisation of PACS is implemented through APCOB, the apex cooperative bank, with the DCCBs and the Cooperation Department. NABARD is the implementing agency at the national level, not in the State.
